title: Inline-editing an `address` on the detail page collapses it to one text box reading `[Object]`, and saving overwrites the structured value with a string
body:
Found while fixing #4037 (display-registry gap for `address`); filed unassigned per Prime Directive #10. **Different defect, different path** — #4037 is the read/display registry, this is the inline-edit **input** path.

## What happens

`InlineFieldInput` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx`) has a type switch that routes `select` / `multiselect`, references, `number`, `currency`, `percent`, `date` / `datetime` to real widgets. `address` matches none of them, so it falls through to the terminal raw text input at the end of the component.

That fallback stringifies an object value through `coerceToSafeValue`:

```
: typeof value === 'object'
  ? String(coerceToSafeValue(value) ?? '')
  : String(value);
```

`coerceToSafeValue` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:317`) has no address branch — a structured address hits its general-object case, which extracts `name || label || externalId || id || _id` and otherwise returns the literal `[Object]`. An address has none of those keys, so the edit box shows **`[Object]`**.

## Why it matters beyond cosmetics

The input is a plain text box wired to `onChange(v)`. Whatever the user types is emitted as a **string**, replacing the structured `{ street, city, state, postalCode, country }` object. So the sub-field structure is destroyed by an ordinary inline edit — and `[Object]` is what the user sees as the current value they are correcting, so editing over it is the natural thing to do.

Contrast the create/edit dialog, which resolves `address` to the real sub-field widget and round-trips the object correctly.

## Reachability

Live today: the desktop detail row enters inline edit on double-click whenever the record is inline-editable (`onEnterInlineEdit` supplied and the field is not readonly / computed / a system field). An `address` field satisfies that.

## Not covered by #4037

PR #4215 fixes the display registry, so the address now reads formatted in read mode **and in the inline-edit read state** (the row before editing starts). It deliberately does not touch any input path. Once a field is actively being edited, `DetailSection` renders `InlineFieldInput` instead of the display value, so this defect is unchanged by that PR.

## Likely shape of a fix

Route `address` to the existing address widget in `InlineFieldInput`'s type switch, the way the form path does — so the structured value is edited as sub-fields and written back as an object. Worth checking the same fall-through for other composite types in that switch while there.
